data.name: Aqeeq
data.long_meaning: Aqeeq is the name given to a feast held for the prophet Ibrahim on the seventh day after the birth of his son Ismail. This feast is commemorated in the Islamic tradition by sacrificing an animal or offering gold or silver as a symbolic act of obedience to Allah.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aqeeq signifies the celebration of the birth of Prophet Ibrahim's son Ismail and the remembrance of Allah's blessings.
data.numerology_meaning: Aqeeq represents the number 5, symbolizing change and versatility, and encouraging personal freedom and exploration.
